management_steps.details: Extremes of age (<20 or >50), malignancy history, constant non-mechanical pain (worse lying down/at night), any motor/sensory neuro deficit, bilateral symptoms, immunosuppression, IVDU, bowel/bladder dysfunction, fever.
Epidural Abscess: start broad antibiotics (Ceftriaxone, Cefazolin, or Vancomycin) and get urgent MRI. Suspected Spinal Metastases: give Dexamethasone 10mg IV stat and get urgent MRI.
